MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  November 6, 2017

A regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to
order at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chambers, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, by
CHAIRMAN YOO.

2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  CHAIRMAN YOO led the assembly in the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.

3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Chair Yoo, Medawar, Carman, Edler, Schachter, Scott,
  Zigrang

  Staff Present:  Planning Director Wahba, Sr. Planner Naughton,
  Associate Planner Thom

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER to,

  APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE ADJOURNED PLANNING COMMISSION
  MEETING OF SEPTEMBER 11, 2017.

  There being no objection, CHAIRMAN YOO so ordered.

5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

  None

6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  A. WAIVE READING IN FULL OF ALL RESOLUTIONS THAT ARE PRESENTED FOR THE
  CONSIDERATION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION ON TONIGHT’S AGENDA AND
  ALL SUCH RESOLUTIONS SHALL BE READ BY TITLE ONLY.

  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR,

  TO APPROVE CONSENT CALENDAR ITEM 6-A.

  There being no objection, CHAIRMAN YOO so ordered.

7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A. PLANNING APPLICATION NO. 24-17; APPLICANT: PROMENADE LLC; 550 DEEP
  VALLEY DRIVE; A request for approval of a Precise Plan of Design, to amend the Master
  Sign Program for 550 Deep valley Drive (Promenade on the Peninsula). (JN)

  Sr. Planner Naughton provided a summary of the staff report and stated that staff
  recommends that the Planning Commission approve Planning Application 24-17, a
  Precise Plan of Design, to amend the Master Sign Program for 550 Deep Valley Drive.

  Jonathan Alpert, General Manager, Promenade on the Peninsula, stated that the shopping
  center has changed and is more of a mixed-use. The intent of this program is to rebrand
  the existing name of the center.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT MOVED, SECONDED BY COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR,

  TO APPROVE PLANNING APPLICATION 24-17.

  Ayes: CHAIR YOO, MEDAWAR, CARMAN, EDLER, SCHACHTER, SCOTT, ZIGRANG
  Noes:
  Absent:
  Abstain:

  1
Planning Commission Minutes
November 6, 2017
   Planning Director Wahba stated that Planning Application 24-17 has been approved;
  there is a 20-day appeal period for this item.

  B. PLANNING APPLICATION NO. 17-17; APPLICANT: ROLLING HILLS DENTAL GROUP;
  LOCATION: 857 SILVER SPUR ROAD; A request to approve a Precise Plan of Design to
  amend the Master Sign Plan for the Town and Country Shopping Center for the
  construction of two new business identification signs with logos for “Rolling Hills Dental
  Group”.

  Associate Planner Thom provided a summary of the staff report and stated that staff
  recommends that the Planning Commission approve PA-17-17 as presented.

  Dr. Jeff Goodman, Rolling Hills Dental group, stated that they are interested in updating
  the look of the building while still blending in with the overall look of the shopping center.
  Additional signage will also be helpful for new patients in finding the building.

  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER MOVED, SECONDED BY COMMISSIONER SCOTT,

  TO APPROVE PLANNING APPLICATION NO. 17-17.

  Ayes: CHAIR YOO, MEDAWAR, CARMAN, EDLER, SCHACHTER, SCOTT, ZIGRANG
  Noes:
  Absent:
  Abstain:

  Planning Director Wahba stated that Planning Application 17-17 has been approved; there
  is a 20-day appeal period for this item.

8.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  None

9.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  None

10.  DIRECTOR ITEMS

  Planning Director Wahba stated that the next Planning Commission meeting is December
  4th. There are four residential applications pending.

  Planning Director Wahba stated that the standing-seam surveys were sent to the residents
  of the Dapplegray neighborhood and are due today, November 6, 2017, however, staff will
  still receive them through the end of the week. Results may be provided at either the
  Planning Commission meeting in December or January. City Council would like the
  results to be presented at their study session, which is held in March.

  Planning Director Wahba stated that a draft calendar with the Planning Commission
  meetings for 2018 will be provided at the next meeting.

  Planning Director Wahba asked if Commissioner’s Yoo, Scott, Medawar, and
  Schachter are still interested in being reappointed to the Planning Commission. All
  Commissioner’s responded, yes.

  Planning Director Wahba introduced Commissioner Edler and welcomed him to the
  Planning Commission.

11.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A. CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS, SEPTEMBER 26, 2017.

  B. CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS, OCTOBER 10, 2017.

  C. CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS, OCTOBER 24, 2017.

  D. DRAFT PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMITTEE MEETING, OCTOBER 16, 2017.

  2

November 6, 2017
   COMMISSIONER SCOTT moved,

  TO RECEIVE AND FILE ITEMS 11-A THROUGH 11-D.

  There being no objection, CHAIRMAN YOO so ordered.

12.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIRMAN YOO adjourned the meeting at 7:25 p.m.
